map.选择检验类型（单样本 t、独立双样本 t、配对 t 或卡方拟合优度），输入对应数: Choose the test type (one-sample t, independent two-sample t, paired t, or chi-square goodness of fit), enter the matching data, and the tool computes the statistic, degrees of freedom, and p value — for judging whether two means differ or whether observed frequencies fit the expected ones.
map.单样本 t 检验：判断样本均值是否与某个理论值（如 μ₀=20）存在显著差异。: One-sample t-test: judges whether the sample mean differs significantly from a theoretical value (such as μ₀=20).
map.独立/配对 t 检验：比较两组均值（如训练前/后、A/B 两组）；配对检验用于同: Independent or paired t-tests compare two means (such as before and after training, or groups A and B); the paired test is for before-and-after measures on the same subjects.
map.卡方拟合优度：判断观测频数分布是否与期望分布（如均匀分布）一致。: Chi-square goodness of fit: judges whether the observed frequency distribution matches an expected distribution (such as uniform).
map.四类检验的默认数据演示: Default data demo of the four test types
map.：①单样本 t：10 个样本均值 25.5000、标准差 8.6699，与 μ₀: : (1) One-sample t: ten samples with mean 25.5000 and standard deviation 8.6699 against μ₀=20 give t=2.0061, df=9, critical ±2.2620 (α=0.05, two-sided); |t| is below the critical value, so H₀ is not rejected. (2) Independent t (equal variances): means 25.500 and 38.333 give t=−3.0533, df=20, critical ±2.0860 — a significant difference. (3) Paired t: mean before-after difference 7.1000, t=25.6422, df=9 — a significant training effect. (4) Chi-square: observed 25/30/20/15/10 with an expected 20 each gives χ²=12.5000, df=4, critical 9.4880, so the uniform distribution hypothesis is rejected.
map.t 检验对数据有什么要求？: What Does a t-Test Require of the Data?
map.通常假设两组数据近似正态、方差齐（独立 t 可选 Welch 校正方差不齐）。样: The usual assumptions are that the two groups are approximately normal with equal variances (for the independent t you can use Welch's correction when they are not). Be careful with very small samples or extreme values, and judge together with the effect size and confidence interval.
map.卡方检验的期望频数怎么给？: How Do You Supply the Expected Frequencies for a Chi-Square Test?
map.留空时按均匀分布（各类别期望相同）处理；也可手动输入期望频数。每类期望频数建议: Left blank it uses a uniform distribution (equal expected counts per class); you can also enter expected frequencies manually. Aim for at least 5 expected per class, or the conclusion becomes less reliable.
